data.context: In the 2024 IP Australia Economic Research Paper 16, *Computer implemented inventions: patent trends at IP Australia, EPO and USPTO*, this passage explains how the study classifies computer-implemented invention applications across Australia, the EPO and the USPTO. “CII-PSM-likely-adverse” means applications similar to Australian applications that received a manner-of-manufacture objection; the classification estimates how they might have been treated in Australia, without assuming jurisdictions use the same legal tests.
